title: Knowledge Distillation of Black-Box Large Language Models (2024)
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of distilling knowledge from black-box large language models where internal activations are inaccessible. The research proposes methods to train smaller student models that mimic the behavior and outputs of proprietary LLMs using only input-output interactions, enabling efficient deployments without API dependencies.
problem_solved: Enables knowledge transfer from closed-source commercial LLMs to smaller open models when only API access is available
why_valuable: Allows organizations to create efficient custom models that capture capabilities of frontier LLMs without ongoing API costs or rate limits
